question: ‘Serve to Win’ is the autobiography of _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Novak Djokovic.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Serve To Win**: Novak Djokovic's life story with diet, exercise, and motivational tips.
 
• In his book "**Serve to Win**", **Djokovic **recounts how he survived the bombing of Belgrade, Serbia, rising from a war-torn childhood to the top tier of his sport.
 
• **Novak Djokovic** reveals the gluten-free diet and fitness plan that transformed his health and pushed him to the pinnacle.
 
• He won ten titles, three Grand Slams, and forty-three consecutive matches.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Rafa: My Story is the autobiography of **Rafael Nadal**.
 
• My Life: Queen of the Court is the autobiography of One of the biggest stars in tennis, **Serena Williams** has captured every major title.
 
• Shuttler’s Flick: Making every match count is the autobiography of Pullela Gopichand.
